 Damian W Betebenner
National Center for the Improvement of Educational Assessment
 Dover, New Hampshire September 6th, 2016

PARCC SGP ANALYSES
• The PARCC consortium conducted SGP analyses following
 the 2016 administration.

• Colorado, District of Columbia, Illinois, Massachusetts,
 Maryland, New Jersey, New Mexico, Rhode Island.

• SGP analyses were conducted for both English Language Arts
 and Mathematics (including Algebra I & II, Geometry, and
 Integrated Math I, II, & III.

• Analyses are Primarily Spring-to-Spring though in states with
 Fall testing, Fall-to-Spring Growth was calculated.

CONCLUSIONS

• Cross state results from PARCC demonstrated both growth
 and status disparities.

• The status disparities were more remarkable than the growth
 disparities.

• Upcoming work will calculate growth-to-standard for each
 state to supplement the norm-referenced analyses.
